Politician(x) ::: x is a politician.

NaziReichstag(x) ::: x is part of the Nazi Reichstag.
Premises:
HeinrichScmidt ::- Heinrich Scmidt was a Nazi German politician.
HeinrichScmidt ::- He was also a member of the Prussian State Parliament and the Nazi Reichstag.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (Politician(x) ∧ NaziReichstag(x)) ::: No politicians are part of the Nazi Reichstag.
